prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic cinematic street portrait of an adult woman in a bright cobalt-blue puffer jacket standing still in the middle of a busy city crowd. She holds intense eye contact with the camera and remains sharply focused while anonymous pedestrians rush around her in dynamic radial long-exposure motion blur. Include an urban background with traffic lights, tall buildings, soft light streaks, and a hint of wind moving loose strands of her dark hair. Use a cool cinematic color grade, natural skin tones, soft overcast daylight, shallow depth of field, an 85mm lens at f/1.8, strong subject isolation, editorial street-photography realism, and portrait 4:5 framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, recognizable bystanders, text, watermark, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, duplicated subject
